Project description
We built an ESPN style live sports and events broadcasting studio which uses the VAST, NVIDIA, YOLO and CoreWeave stack for automated directing, switching the camera, creating replays and adding overlays and commentary to give a professional experience. Think of it as your personal camera van for any event you want to have produced professionally- now possible in seconds and at a fraction of the cost.
